contract: Oban 2.24.2 translation: unique job per (queue, job_key), enqueue that reports only persisted job ids (conflict without id is {:retry, :unique_lock_held}), a per-queue runner registration and an Oban worker that traps exits, maps an escaping exit to a snooze and refuses unknown args versions, and a Relay over one ELZ-009 outbox stream that acks :done items, keeps skipped items pending and continues within the page.
limits: Subset only: no general Oban wrapper, cron, Pro features, batch/workflow or cross-stream outbox discovery.
Relay delivery is at-least-once; pending/3 returns the oldest page with no offset, so a full page of permanently skipped items blocks later items (stated limit).
Oban uniqueness is an advisory lock plus query, not a database constraint; Lifeline rescue is time-based and can re-run live jobs (upstream).
The runner registration is node-local :persistent_term state set by the consumer's Assembly; no cross-node registry.

grounding.claim: Unique changeset, persisted-id enqueue under a held unique lock, worker dispatch/exit trapping/version refusal, a real Oban execution, relay ack/skip/in-page continuation, full-page block limit and option validation on a disposable PostgreSQL and Memory; finite scenarios.

Oban 2.24.2 job persistence, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim, retry staging, unique insert (advisory lock plus query, not a constraint), snooze attempt handling, cancel_all_jobs and Lifeline time-based rescue (documented to rescue live jobs) are upstream contracts.
Ecto SQL 3.14.0 Repo, transaction and in_transaction?/0 semantics are upstream contracts.
PostgreSQL transaction atomicity, row locking, advisory locks and READ COMMITTED behaviour reached through Postgrex 0.22.4 are upstream server contracts, not local proofs.
Elixir validation, exceptions, exit trapping and BEAM execution are upstream contracts, not proved here.
OTP 29.1.2 GenServer, Supervisor, Task.Supervisor, links/monitors and :persistent_term semantics are upstream contracts; no exactly-once or disk durability guarantee.
The consumer owns the Oban instance, queues, Lifeline settings and Oban.Migration; rescue_after exceeds normal attempt duration.

telemetry.contract: Oban [:oban, :job, :start|:stop|:exception] and plugin events; Elzoo adds none.

config.contract: Construction-time Relay store, stream, handle, limit and interval (fixed, no hot change); per-insert queue, job_key and provider max_attempts.

control.contract: Oban queue pause/resume and cancel_all_jobs are upstream; the Relay has OTP start/stop only, no pause/drain command.
